entry.hypothesis: Names whose trailing-63-session purchase value is >= 0.2 basis points of market cap (the calibrated median among purchasers) beat the basket; dollar conviction scaled by firm size (PREREG H6).
entry.rationale: A purchase that is large relative to the firm moves the insider's wealth materially into it; scaling by market cap removes the mechanical dollar advantage of large firms.

stopped_names.rule: D07: a holding is sold at the close of its last stored print; no open is fabricated
